task: Audit strict release gate evidence freshness before compiler integration
observation: The public --strict CLI returned 0 with 62 PASS records whose test paths did not exist, implementation SHAs were all zero, and evidence text was placeholder. Existing fault injections exercised validate_gate_evidence directly but never the public strict path.
impact: The advertised release gate could accept a forged ledger despite its validator helper rejecting the same records.

resolution.summary: Strict and ordinary ledger execution now share structural/evidence validation. Strict release adds external post-commit per-gate reports, exact HEAD freshness, complete engine coverage and hashed execution logs; regression probes exercise both global and --gate CLI paths.
